title: Replace BCF header leaves (bcf_hdr_add_sample, bcf_hdr_append, bcf_hdr_sync, bcf_hdr_destroy, bcf_hdr_get_version) with pure Rust
description: Replace 5 BCF header FFI leaf functions: bcf_hdr_add_sample (8 lines), bcf_hdr_append (8 lines), bcf_hdr_sync (33 lines, rebuild hash), bcf_hdr_destroy (35 lines), bcf_hdr_get_version (9 lines). All are leaves. Used in src/bcf/header.rs. Complexity: easy.
